note:
The front horse pawing the ground WITH THE DOOR OPEN.

Without this the idle-break had no door-open variant, so every time it fired the coach fell back to the STATELESS clip -- the closed door -- and the driver's overlay rect fell back with it. The door slammed shut and open again, and a second driver appeared at the closed clip's rect. One fault, two symptoms, both reported by watching.

A STATE THAT EXISTS ON ONE CLIP AND NOT ANOTHER IS A STATE THAT UNSETS ITSELF whenever the other plays.
